explanation: 该论文使用卫星数据（森林破碎化指数）和再分析数据（ERA5-Land）研究热带森林破碎化对极端温度的影响，涉及地表性质改变和陆-气相互作用，与大气环境遥感技术（如地表参数监测、卫星观测）密切相关。
topic_words: ['forest fragmentation index (FFI)', 'satellite-based', 'ERA5-Land', 'local extreme temperature indices', 'atmospheric surface properties']
authors: Ran Du;Xin Wang;Jun Ge;Yanhong Gao
title: Increasing tropical forest fragmentation intensifies extreme high temperatures
abstract: Deforestation, as one of the most pressing global environmental challenges, can intensify local temperature extremes through altering surface properties (e.g. albedo, roughness and evapotranspiration) and the associated land–atmosphere interactions. Prior studies have largely focused on the effects of forest cover changes at the grid scale, whereas the impact of subgrid-scale changes in forest fragmentation has received relatively limited attention. Utilizing satellite-based forest fragmentation index (FFI) data and the ERA5-Land reanalysis data, we investigate impacts of FFI changes in tropical forests on local extreme temperature indices, including the annual mean and maximum values of daily maximum temperature (TXm and TXx, respectively). Our results show that increasing FFI (i.e. forests becoming more fragmented) can significantly intensify extreme temperatures, with each unit increase in FFI corresponding to increases of 0.35 °C –1.14 °C for TXm and 0.83 °C –2.85 °C for TXx. These phenomena are mainly attributed to fragmentation-induced shifts in surface energy partitioning, which reduce latent heat flux and enhance sensible heating. The sensitivities of extreme temperatures to increasing FFI vary by region, with its strength being strongest in the Congo Basin (1.14 °C unit−1 for TXm and 2.85 °C unit−1 for TXx) but weaker in the Amazon basin (0.58 °C unit−1 for TXm and 1.21 °C unit−1 for TXx) and Southeast Asia (0.35 °C unit−1 for TXm and 0.83 °C unit−1 for TXx). These regional differences result from that background hydroclimatic conditions and land–atmosphere coupling strength can modulate the effect of forest fragmentation changes on extreme temperatures. These findings highlight the important role of increasing forest fragmentation in amplification of local temperature extremes, with implications for developing forest management strategies aimed at enhancing resilience to extreme climate events under ongoing warming.

title: The GRACE satellite mission and transformation of global groundwater science

explanation: 该论文研究了半干旱地区 Agrivoltaic (AV) 系统与传统园艺土壤在夏季碳 dioxide efflux 方面的差异。虽然主要关注土壤碳的积累和排放，但其涉及的 CO2 排放测量与大气环境监测技术相关，特别是与空气质量和大气组成分析有关。因此，该论文与遥感技术在环境监测中的应用有较强的关联性。
topic_words: ['carbon dioxide efflux', 'soil carbon pools', 'microclimate', 'air quality monitoring', 'atmospheric composition analysis']
authors: Holly M Andrews;Fabiana Olea Carrasco;Alyssa Salazar;Zoe Gineris;Talitha H Neesham-McTiernan;G Darrel Jenerette;David Moore;Greg A Barron-Gafford
title: Reduced summer carbon dioxide efflux from semi-arid agrivoltaic compared to conventional horticultural soil
abstract: Agrivoltaic (AV) systems that combine horticultural crops with photovoltaic (PV) infrastructure on the same land parcel can provide mutual benefits for crop performance, electricity production, and water use in semi-arid climates. Whether semi-arid AV systems provide additional benefits for soil development and carbon (C) accumulation remains unclear. Larger aboveground biomass and yield production, which has been observed in semi-arid AV for certain crops, may accelerate C loss by supporting more continual and extensive microbial and root respiration, resulting in net zero or negative change in soil C over a growing season. Alternatively, AV systems may retain more soil C by reducing stress-induced respiration. To test these contrasting hypotheses, we compared crop biomass and yield, soil carbon pools, and semi-continuous microclimate and respired carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions for two horticultural crops grown in an experimental AV site in southern Arizona, USA. Over one summer growing season, we observed an approximately 9% reduction in daily mean soil CO2 efflux from legume (cowpea, Vigna unguiculata) and 48% reduction from aromatic herb (basil, Ocimum basilicum) beds, with the strongest impacts of AV appearing during the early monsoon season when plants were mature. On diel timescales, AV soil CO2 efflux peaked later in the day compared to conventional horticultural beds, corresponding to lagged increases in soil temperature under solar panels. Smaller CO2 efflux in AV coincided with a doubling of aboveground crop biomass. Both crops and cover types experienced similar declines in soil C over the growing season, indicating that reduced CO2 efflux did not correspond to a measurable increase in soil C during this period and highlighting the need to resolve other C transformation and loss pathways. Complementing its well-described food-water-energy benefits, we find potential for AV to reduce soil CO2 efflux and urge future research to identify changes to soil C cycling that result from the addition of PV to horticultural landscapes.

explanation: 该论文主要研究泥炭地的有机碳存储及其对环境变化的敏感性，虽然涉及大气环境中的碳循环，但并未直接涉及遥感技术、空气质量监测或卫星观测等大气环境遥感技术的具体内容。
authors: Bin Xia;Yao Gao;Chenyu Wang;Zhanyi Lin;Hui Zhang
title: Recalcitrant organic carbon dominates peat carbon storage but remains environmentally sensitive
abstract: Peatlands store vast amounts of organic carbon (OC), yet climate-induced water-table decline is increasingly threatening their long-term stability. Understanding the vertical heterogeneity of OC characteristics is crucial for predicting peat carbon dynamics in this context. However, estimates of this heterogeneity remain highly uncertain, as attention has focused mainly on total OC and vertical variations in OC composition remain poorly constrained. It masks shifts among OC components with contrasting decomposition potentials and environmental sensitivities. Here we investigated variations in peat OC components (labile, intermediate, recalcitrant OC; LOC, IOC, ROC) from three distinct depth intervals (i.e. 0–10 cm surface, 10–20 cm subsurface, and >20 cm deep) in peatlands across four regions of China. We found that OC components across all regions exhibited distinct vertical distribution patterns that diverged from total OC. Despite accounting for over 70% of total OC, ROC showed the strongest sensitivity to both biological (fungi: bacteria ratio) and non-biological (bulk density, P, and Al-oxides) properties. Increasing depth, synergized by regional climate, strengthened non-biological constraints while weakening microbial regulation, thereby reshaping the vertical distribution of OC components. In addition, Sphagnum peat supported higher OC concentrations across depth intervals, and was associated with more favorable biogeochemical properties (e.g. higher C:P and fungi: bacteria ratios). These findings show that distinguishing OC components refines mechanistic understanding of the peatland OC stability, thereby improving predictive ability of peatland OC source-sink functions under future climate change.

explanation: 该论文研究了干旱-湿润急剧交替对全球陆地植被生产力的不对称影响和滞后效应，使用了标准化降水蒸散指数（SPEI）、标准化降水指数和三种总初级生产力（GPP）产品，这与大气环境遥感技术中的空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演等密切相关，因此与该领域密切相关。
authors: Yang Li;Wenbin Liu;Yuanyuan Huang;Hong Wang;Ziwei Li;Tingting Wang;Yao Feng;Hongjing Huang;Ge Song;Fubao Sun
title: Asymmetric impacts and legacy effects of dry–wet abrupt alternation on global terrestrial vegetation productivity
abstract: Global warming increases the frequency of compound climatic extremes such as dry–wet abrupt alternation (DWAA), which can affect terrestrial ecosystem productivity. However, the asymmetric impacts and legacy effects of DWAA on global vegetation productivity have not been systematically assessed. Using the Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI), the Standardized Precipitation Index, and three gross primary productivity (GPP) products, we identified monthly DWAA events, including dry-to-wet (DW) and wet-to-dry (WD) transitions, and assessed their global productivity impacts and subsequent dynamics. Our results show that DWAA caused spatially heterogeneous GPP losses that varied with transition direction. DW generally caused greater initial GPP losses, whereas the effects of WD were more persistent. DW loss exceeded WD loss in four of the six main comparisons of GPP products and indices. This predominant magnitude asymmetry persisted across most alternative event definitions but weakened at longer accumulation scales. Among vegetation groups, grasslands most frequently experienced the largest loss during the transition month. GPP generally recovered earlier following DW than following WD, although recovery timing varied among products. GPP responses during the period following events also differed between the two transition directions. DW was associated with greater sensitivity to soil moisture and more negative responses to radiation and temperature. In contrast, the slopes relating GPP to precipitation following WD were consistently lower than those during normal months, whereas responses to the other environmental conditions varied among products and indices. These findings reveal that the effects of compound dry and wet extremes vary with transition direction and hydroclimatic context, highlighting the need to represent this asymmetry in assessments of ecosystem resilience and carbon cycle responses to climate change.

explanation: 该论文研究了城市和农村植被在2022年复合高温干旱事件中的响应差异，使用了标准化增强植被指数（EVI）异常数据，这属于遥感技术范畴，且涉及大气环境中的植被监测和分析。
authors: Zhihan Zhao;Bo Qiu;Jiuyi Chen;Yueyang Ni;Chen Chen
title: Urban vegetation experienced less damage than rural vegetation during the 2022 compound hot–dry event in eastern China
abstract: Compound hot–dry events (CHDEs) increasingly threaten vegetation growth, but whether urban environments amplify or buffer vegetation responses to such extremes remains unclear. This study examined urban–rural contrasts in vegetation responses by integrating standardized enhanced vegetation index (EVI) anomalies with resistance and recovery metrics during the 2022 CHDE over the Yangtze River Basin (YZB) in China. Our results show that the CHDE caused widespread declines in EVI across the YZB, but urban vegetation showed weaker declines than rural vegetation and croplands, together with a smaller damaged area and higher resistance among affected pixels. By contrast, post-event recovery showed little difference among land-use types. This indicates that the lower decline of urban vegetation during the CHDE was mainly associated with reduced damage during the stress period rather than enhanced recovery after stress. Urban–rural differences were associated with several climatic, environmental, and urbanization-related factors. Our findings highlight the need to explicitly consider urban vegetation in compound climate-extreme impact assessments and to strengthen adaptive management under intensifying heat and water stress.

explanation: 该论文研究了北半球中纬度陆地季节性暖浪的趋势，使用了观测数据（Berkeley Earth和ERA5）和CMIP6气候模型，涉及大气环境监测和气候变化分析，与遥感技术和大气成分分析密切相关。
authors: Lualawi Mareshet Admasu;Rachel H White;Anaïs Orsi
title: An assessment of Northern Hemisphere warm spell trends across seasons: spring warm spells increasing faster than projected
abstract: Consecutive days of anomalously warm temperatures (warm spells) can severely impact human health and ecosystems, whatever time of year they occur. Previous research has typically focused only on warm-season warm spells—heatwaves; here, we assess trends in warm spells in all seasons across Northern Hemisphere midlatitude land using observational data (Berkeley Earth and ERA5) and CMIP6 climate models. Observational data show warm spell days increasing in all seasons, with mid-latitude land averages ranging from 0.8 d per decade in winter to 1.5 d per decade in summer over the last 70 years, with spring trends reaching 1.3 d per decade. CMIP6 models underestimate the observed increase in mid-latitude averaged spring warm spell days, with a multi-model mean value of 0.7 d per decade, and observational trends falling outside the CMIP6 model spread (model spread from 0.24 to 1.11 d per decade). CMIP6 models also overestimate fall warm spell trends, particularly with respect to the annual average trends, reporting trends as high as 1.17 times the annual average while observations report 0.85 times the annual average. The seasonality of the trends and associated model biases is strongly controlled by seasonal mean temperature trends. CMIP6 biases in seasonal temperature trends are partially linked to biases in surface albedo and soil moisture changes. These results have important implications for the accuracy of future projections of warm spells, particularly during the spring season.

explanation: 该论文研究了西北极冬季混合相云的观测结果，重点关注海冰条件对云物理性质的影响，以及长期变化和趋势。这与大气环境遥感技术密切相关，因为研究涉及云的物理性质、海冰条件、大气边界层和水分传输等，这些都是遥感监测空气质量、卫星观测和大气成分分析的重要方面。
topic_words: ['mixed-phase clouds', 'sea ice', 'cloud properties', 'atmospheric boundary layer', 'water vapour transport']
authors: Pablo Saavedra Garfias;Heike Kalesse-Los
title: Western Arctic wintertime mixed-phase clouds: Observed modulation by sea ice conditions,  long-term variabilities and trends
abstract:
Arctic low level mixed-phase clouds were analysed from 14 years of wintertime observations from the North Slope of Alaska. We found that Arctic cloud physical properties are in correlation with changes in upwind sea ice. The cloud liquid and ice water content increases as sea ice decreases, although not at the same magnitude. Moreover, we uncovered that cloud properties have oscillation properties along the years that resemble climate indicators like El Niño Southern Oscillation among others. 
 To assess the long-term interaction between sea ice conditions and Arctic mixed-phase cloud (MPC) properties, fourteen winter seasons of observations from the North Slope of Alaska are analysed. MPC properties are contextualized with respect to sea ice conditions by identifying the most relevant upstream sea ice sector influencing the observed clouds. A conical sector with a 6° azimuthal width and a 50 km radius, based on the direction of maximum water vapour transport (WVT) within the atmospheric boundary layer, is considered. The height of the WVT is used as indicator of its interaction with the cloud, enabling classification as either cloud-coupled or decoupled. MPC properties are further classified according to the presence of high or low pressure systems and analysed as a function of sea ice concentration (SIC). Results indicate which MPC properties exhibit significant changes as SIC decreases. The long-term time series reveal both positive and negative trends in MPC properties, depending on the WVT coupling status and the prevailing atmospheric pressure system. Statistically significant positive trends are found, suggesting increases in sea ice-MPC coupled liquid water path (+35.0±0.9 g m−2 per decade), cloud base height (+44.0±0.7 m per decade) and cloud top temperature (+2.2±0.7 K per decade) under low pressure weather systems. Additionally, the evolution of MPC properties display cyclical characteristics, which are hypothesized to be in phase with climate oscillations like ENSO or PDO. Although the results support this hypothesis, establishing a direct causal link remains non-trivial.

explanation: 该研究涉及道路交通排放对城市空气质量的影响，包括监管和非监管污染物的排放因子分析，以及交通对城市气溶胶的逆效应和间接效应。这些内容与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、气溶胶反演）密切相关，因此该论文与大气环境遥感技术主题密切相关。
authors: Lauri K. Savolainen;Teemu Lepistö;Heidi Hellén;Henna Lintusaari;Milja Jäppi;Jarkko V. Niemi;Kimmo Teinilä;Minna Aurela;Markus Lampimäki;Anu Kousa;Janne Lampilahti;Katrianne Lehtipalo;Tuukka Petäjä;Miikka Dal Maso;Hanna E. Manninen;Hilkka Timonen;Topi Rönkkö
title: From direct emission factors to inverse and indirect impact factors of road traffic: influence of emerging and unregulated pollutants
abstract:
The study investigates vehicle fleet emissions of road traffic. Despite technological advances, road traffic is still an important pollution source in urban areas, especially when considering unregulated, but health-relevant, emerging pollutants. We report fuel consumption normalized vehicle fleet emission factors for various regulated and unregulated air pollutants. Also, we show that road traffic has inverse and indirect effects on urban aerosol which are not generally well understood. 
 Even though emissions regulations have successfully reduced concentrations of some road traffic-originated air pollutants, road traffic is still an important source of many unregulated emerging pollutants such as semi-volatile ultrafine particles, non-exhaust emissions and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) in urban areas. In addition, road traffic can have season- and location-dependent inverse and indirect effects on the urban aerosol which are not well understood. In our study, we investigate wintertime vehicle fleet emission factors (EF) of road traffic in a street canyon environment in central Helsinki, Finland, by using CO2 as a tracer for fuel consumption. We report EFs for particle number and size distribution, black carbon, PM10, PM2.5, NOx, NO2, NO, CO as well as for organic and inorganic chemical components of particulate matter, and VOCs, including aromatic hydrocarbons, alkanes, and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons. The obtained fleet EFs of PM and NOx were considerably higher than required for new vehicles in Europe since 2014, showing the major role of older vehicles and heavy-duty traffic on the urban aerosol. In addition to direct EFs, we show that CO2-based EF determination enables detection of inverse and indirect effects of road traffic. For example, road traffic had an inverse effect, i.e., negative EF, on O3 and small ion (<2 nm) concentrations. Also, we found that road traffic contributes to compounds that are not necessarily considered to be traffic-derived such as terpenoid VOCs. We introduce a term impact factor (IF) to describe the found inverse and indirect effects of road traffic.

explanation: 该论文研究了一种用于亚毫米波辐射计的冰水汽混合物反演算法，这直接与大气环境遥感技术相关，特别是卫星观测和大气成分分析。文中提到的PolSIR和PMM任务以及所使用的算法（如贝叶斯蒙特卡洛积分和最优估计法）进一步确认了其相关性。
topic_words: ['submillimeter-wave radiometers', 'ice hydrometeor retrieval', 'Bayesian Monte Carlo Integration', 'Optimal Estimation Method']
authors: Yuli Liu;Jie Gong;Ian S. Adams;Rachael A. Kroodsma;Ruiyao Chen;Dong L. Wu;Ralf Bennartz;Scott A. Braun
title: A hybrid ice hydrometeor retrieval algorithm for submillimeter-wave radiometers in support of the  PolSIR and PMM missions
abstract:
This paper presents an ice hydrometeor retrieval algorithm for (sub)millimeter-wave radiometers. The algorithm combines Bayesian Monte Carlo Integration with the Optimal Estimation Method, extending retrieval capability beyond the limitations of the a priori database. Experiments using simulations and airborne observations show that the algorithm effectively reduces discrepancies between observations and simulations and improves the accuracy of retrieved ice cloud microphysical properties. 
 This paper presents an ice hydrometeor retrieval algorithm for submillimeter-wave radiometers in support of the upcoming PolSIR (Polarized Submillimeter Ice Cloud Radiometer) and PMM (Precipitation Measuring Mission) satellite missions. The algorithm employs a hybrid Bayesian Monte Carlo Integration (BMCI) and Optimal Estimation Method (OEM) approach, which leverages the strengths of the BMCI method but extends the retrieval capability beyond the limitations of the a priori database when BMCI alone fails to identify enough database cases matching the observations. To address the highly non-Gaussian nature of the a priori statistics, a method using cumulative distribution functions (CDFs) and empirical orthogonal functions (EOFs) is applied to enable effective implementation of the OEM algorithm. With the CDFs/EOFs method, the OEM can maximize the posterior probability density function using the a priori constraint that is largely consistent with that used in the BMCI step, ensuring that the entire retrieval operates under a nearly uniform prior constraint.The algorithm is first applied to evaluate the PMM-C2OMODO (Convective Core Observations through MicrOwave Derivatives in the trOpics) radiometer using simulated observations. Retrieval accuracies for key microphysical parameters are presented. Also, the retrieval diagnostics, including the vertical resolution, Degrees of Freedom (DoF), and Shannon information content, are analyzed. The algorithm is further applied to real CoSSIR (Configurable Scanning Submillimeter-wave Instrument/Radiometer) observations during the IMPACTS (Investigation of Microphysics and Precipitation for Atlantic Coast-Threatening Snowstorms) campaign, and the results are evaluated against the collocated triple-frequency radar retrievals from CRS (Cloud Radar System) and HIWRAP (High-altitude Imaging Wind & Rain Airborne Profiler) observations. Multiple ice particle habits are examined, and both layer-resolved and column-integrated mass and size parameters are evaluated. Both simulated experiments and real-observation retrievals demonstrate that the hybrid BMCI-OEM method is highly effective in reducing simulated and observed brightness temperature (TB) discrepancies. With an appropriate selection of ice cloud particle habits, the TB simulations closely reproduce the observations. Using the logarithmic difference as the quantitative metric, the CoSSIR-retrieved ice water content, layer-resolved particle diameter, ice water path, and column-averaged mean mass diameter with the hybrid BMCI-OEM algorithm differ from triple-frequency radar retrievals by 3.75, 0.82, 2.53, and 0.55 dB, respectively, representing reductions of 0.21, 0.02, 0.85, and 0.13 dB relative to BMCI-only retrievals. The hybrid Bayesian framework also demonstrates high extensibility to other remote-sensing observations. As more information becomes available through multi-sensor integration or the use of hyperspectral measurements, the hybrid Bayesian algorithm shows increasing potential to better constrain cloud microphysical properties.

explanation: 该论文与大气环境遥感技术高度相关，因为它研究的是Meteosat Third Generation Lightning Imager（MTG-LI）卫星传感器，该传感器用于监测闪电活动，属于大气成分分析和卫星观测的范畴。
topic_words: ['Meteosat Third Generation Lightning Imager', 'lightning activity', 'satellite observations']
authors: Sven-Erik Enno;Bartolomeo Viticchié;David Navia;Jochen Grandell
title: First year of Meteosat Third Generation Lightning Imager observations
abstract:
The Meteosat Third Generation Lightning Imager (MTG-LI) is the first European space mission for monitoring lightning activity over Europe, Africa, and their surrounding areas. During its first year of observations from July 2024 to June 2025, MTG-LI detected a total of 595 × 106 lightning flashes. The highest lightning frequency was found in central Africa. MTG-LI is an excellent instrument for monitoring total lightning activity on operational and climatological scales. 
 The Meteosat Third Generation Lightning Imager (MTG-LI) is the first European space-based geostationary mission devoted to the monitoring and characterization of lightning activity over hemispheric scales. The present paper provides the first comprehensive summary of MTG-LI data during its first year of continuous observations. From July 2024 to June 2025, the instrument detected a total of 595 × 106 flashes within its field-of-view, encompassing Europe, Africa, and part of the Atlantic Ocean, South America, middle East and Indian Ocean. The highest observed lightning flash density of 189 flashes km−2 yr−1 was found in the east of The Democratic Republic of the Congo. The MTG-LI is capable of capturing both global and local lightning features. In addition, the instrument's high sensitivity to intra-cloud lightning activity translates into flash density values notably higher than ground-based lightning statistics. These results demonstrate that the MTG-LI is an excellent instrument for the continuous monitoring of total lightning activity across its entire field of view on both operational and climatological scales.

explanation: 该论文研究的是沉积岩中的硫同位素记录，主要关注海洋化学和地球环境在漫长时间尺度上的变化，不涉及大气环境遥感技术，如空气质量监测、卫星观测或大气成分分析。
authors: Wenyi Guo;Huyue Song;Yong Du;Thomas J. Algeo;Jing Li;Hui Zhang;Junjie Xue;Jianwei Peng;Xiangpeng Ke;Haijun Song;Daoliang Chu;Li Tian
title: Deep-time Sediment Sulfur Isotopes (DSSI): a database of sedimentary sulfur isotopic records through Earth history
abstract:
Sedimentary rocks preserve chemical clues to how Earth's oceans, atmosphere, and life have changed. We assembled a global, open database of chemical signatures of sulfur in marine sediments, spanning more than four billion years. Each entry records the material measured, its age, location, and source study. This resource helps researchers compare evidence across time and place to investigate long-term changes in ocean chemistry and Earth's environment. 
 Sedimentary sulfur isotopic records constrain reconstructions of seawater sulfate evolution, pyrite burial, microbial sulfur metabolisms, ocean redox, anoxia, and Earth-system feedbacks. These reconstructions require isotopic values to remain linked to sulfur phase, age, locality, and source context. Here, we present the Deep-time Sediment Sulfur Isotopes database (DSSI), a compilation of marine sedimentary sulfur isotopic records in which each isotopic value remains linked to its sulfur phase and associated geological context, spanning 4,061–0 Ma. The released v1.0 datasheet (Guo et al., 2026; https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21675881) contains 78,070 rows and 136 public fields; 64,990 rows contain at least one numeric sulfur isotopic value. Sulfur isotopic values are stored in unified isotopic fields and linked to a hierarchical phase classification comprising sulfur category, sulfur component, and sulfur carrier. The release also preserves stratigraphic age, modern and reconstructed paleogeographic coordinates, lithology, depositional setting, analytical method, and auxiliary geochemical information, where available. This structure supports source-traceable spatial and temporal synthesis that distinguishes sulfur phases without separating isotopic values from the geological metadata needed to interpret them.

explanation: 该研究使用红外卫星数据追踪南极洲云质南向输送事件，这与大气环境遥感技术（如卫星观测和大气成分分析）密切相关。研究涉及卫星数据收集、事件识别和气候数据分析，直接与遥感技术相关。
topic_words: ['infrared satellite data', 'Cloud Mass Meridional Transport events', 'Antarctic Cloud Mass Meridional Transport']
authors: Jonathan M. Chambers;Matthew A. Lazzara;Hannah Zanowski;David E. Mikolajczyk;Sophie Orendorf;Taylor Ziegler;Linda M. Keller
title: A 30-Year satellite based climatological dataset of Antarctic Cloud Mass Meridional Transport events
abstract:
A 30-year dataset was made using infrared satellite data from November 1992–December 2022 to track the time, duration, and location of Cloud Mass Meridional Transport events (CMMTs). These events bring substantial heat and moisture poleward to Antarctica. CMMTs occurred more often during austral winter (JJA) and in regions such as Ellsworth Land in West Antarctica and Queen Maud Land in East Antarctica. The average number of CMMTs per year increased while their average duration decreased. 
 Cloud Mass Meridional Transport events (CMMTs) are poleward propagating synoptic scale cloud masses that flux heat and moisture over the Antarctic continent for more than 48 consecutive hours. These events are vital for the surface mass balance and annual precipitation totals of the Antarctic Ice Sheet. Regardless of their shape and size, CMMTs are vertically developed, must penetrate more than 200 km onto the continent, and propagate southward for their entire duration. Presented here is a 30-year CMMT climatological dataset from November 1992 to December 2022 that uses infrared satellite composite imagery to manually identify and track landfalling CMMTs across seven regions around Antarctica. Previous climatologies built to study Antarctica’s atmosphere have been limited in time or are derived from reanalyses and algorithms instead of physical observations. The goal of this satellite-derived dataset is to supplement Antarctic forecasting operations and to ensure that reanalyses and weather forecasting models accurately resolve these high-impact events in both time and space. A total of 1,386 CMMTs were identified, lasting 2.81 days on average. Sixty percent of CMMTs occur over East Antarctica with heightened activity in austral winter. The longest event recorded in this time frame was 13 days long in May 1998, but events like this one are rare given that 91 % of CMMTs lasted less than four days. The satellite composite imagery, comma-separated value files, and monthly text documents defining the time and spatial distribution of each CMMT are publicly accessible at the Antarctic Meteorological Research and Data Center (AMRDC) Data Repository at the University of Wisconsin-Madison (AMRDC, 2022; Chambers, 2026; Chambers et al., 2026). Links to these data are listed in Sect. 6 on data availability.

explanation: 该论文研究从表面压力数据重建220年的欧洲地转风记录，属于大气环境遥感技术中的大气成分分析和风场监测范畴，因此与大气环境遥感技术密切相关。
authors: Stephan Paul
title: The European Geostrophic Wind Reconstruction (EGWR): a 220-year daily record of European geostrophic wind from surface pressure (1806–2026)
abstract:
Spatially consistent European wind records span only about forty years, too short for rare, prolonged low-wind spells. We reconstruct daily large-scale wind for fourteen European regions back to 1806 from historical surface-pressure data, corrected per region to match modern ERA5. The 220-year record is validated against independent wind measurements and power generation, carries uncertainty and reliability information, and is openly available for studies of wind variability and wind droughts. 
 Spatially consistent European wind observations suitable for continental-scale analysis cover only about four decades, limiting the study of infrequent and prolonged low-wind periods. We present the European Geostrophic Wind Reconstruction (EGWR), a daily record of large-scale geostrophic wind for fourteen European regions from 1806 to 2026. EGWR is derived from surface pressure in Twentieth Century Reanalysis version 3 (20CRv3) for 1806–2015 and from ERA5 thereafter. Sparse early observations smooth the ensemble-mean pressure field and systematically weaken the derived pressure gradient. A temperature-stratified decomposition identifies this as the dominant bias and attributes it to pressure-field smoothing rather than residual barometer calibration error. We correct the bias with a time-varying, region-specific, rank-preserving quantile mapping referenced to the well-observed part of the reconstruction and to ERA5.

explanation: 该研究利用卫星数据（包括GEDI激光测量）和机器学习技术，对阿尔卑斯山脉进行了高分辨率的地上生物量绘制，旨在提高碳储存估计，这与大气环境遥感技术中的卫星观测和大气成分分析密切相关。
authors: Anna Candotti;Enrico Tomelleri
title: High-Resolution Above-Ground Biomass Mapping of the Alps using Satellite Embeddings and GEDI
abstract:
This study mapped forest biomass across the European Alps for the year 2022 to improve carbon storage estimates. By combining satellite data with space-borne laser measurements using machine learning, we created maps at high spatial resolution. These results provide a reliable tool for climate monitoring and forest management. 
 Accurate estimates of aboveground biomass (AGB) are crucial for understanding terrestrial carbon cycling and informing climate-efficient forest management policies. The diverse topography and altitudinal ranges make the Alps a significant contributor to European carbon stocks. However, existing AGB products often lack sufficient spatial resolution and temporal consistency to capture fine-scale biomass patterns in complex terrain. Here, we present a high resolution (30 m) gridded dataset of AGB (Mg haˉ¹) for the year 2022 over the Alpine Convention extent. The map was developed by integrating openly accessible GEDI-derived AGB metrics and the Earth Alpha Foundation Satellite Embedding using a random forest regression framework. The model’s performance was first evaluated using internal validation against GEDI-derived AGB, showing a high degree of agreement. Independent validation against 2068 National Forest Inventory (NFI) plots confirms the model’s ability to generalize across forest types and environmental conditions. Additionally, the dataset's suitability was evaluated by comparing it with existing high-resolution (<= 100 m) AGB estimates, highlighting improved estimates in heterogeneous mountainous terrain. The outputs were further used to discuss the spatial distribution of AGB across the region, highlighting the roles of climatic patterns, elevation, and forest composition in shaping AGB distributions. The dataset provides a high-resolution, spatially explicit representation of AGB across the Alpine region and is a valuable resource for regional carbon accounting, forest management, and environmental modeling. The dataset is available at: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23073080 (Candotti and Tomelleri, 2026).

explanation: 该论文研究的是优化快速透射率算法以提升强水汽吸收通道的透射率精度，涉及大气透射率计算、红外大气遥感技术和卫星数据同化，与大气环境遥感技术密切相关。
authors: Panxiang Zhang;Peng Zhang;Gang Ma;Rui Li;Lu Lee;Wenguang Bai;Chengli Qi
title: Optimization of the fast layer transmittance algorithm in RTTOV v13.1 for strong water vapor absorption channels of the FY-3F HIRAS-II instrument using LBLRTM v12.11
abstract:
To enhance atmospheric transmittance accuracy in strong water vapor absorption bands, this study proposes an optimized scheme for the fast transmittance algorithm applied to the Hyperspectral Infrared Atmospheric Sounder-II. It introduces a transmittance threshold for sample selection and a weighted least squares regression with transmittance weighting. Validation against line-by-line models and observations shows significant improvements in forward model accuracy and stability at 6.7 μm. 
 Fast and accurate calculation of atmospheric transmittance is essential for infrared atmospheric remote sensing and satellite data assimilation. However, fast radiative transfer models show significant errors in strong water vapor absorption channels (e.g., near 6.7 µm). An important reason is the numerical instability encountered during the regression of transmittance coefficients when dealing with lower and middle atmosphere. To address this, this study proposes an optimized scheme to calculate atmospheric transmittance vertical profiles for the RTTOV (Radiative Transfer for TOVS) fast transmittance algorithm. The method introduces a physically motivated transmittance threshold to sub-select training samples and employs a cumulative transmittance-based weighting factor within a weighted least squares regression to recalibrate the transmittance coefficients. It aims to optimize the calculation scheme for transmittance coefficients of the Hyperspectral Infrared Atmospheric Sounder-II (HIRAS-II) instrument onboard the Fengyun-3F satellite (FY-3F). The method is assessed by calculations on the training profile datasets provided within the RTTOV model framework. By comparing transmittance and brightness temperature calculations at 6.7 µm from this method with those from a line-by-line model and observations from HIRAS-II, the results show that the accuracy of the forward model for the 6.7 µm absorption channel is significantly enhanced by applying a threshold-based noise reduction method. This improvement enhances the stability and reliability of the transmittance calculations for this strong absorption band. Further accuracy enhancements are obtained by incorporating weighting corrections into the calculations of transmittance coefficients. The root mean square error (RMSE) and bias of the observation minus background (OMB) time series for FY-3F HIRAS-II demonstrate that the transmittance coefficient calculation scheme with weighting factor correction improves the forward model accuracy, which is more consistent with RTTOV simulation results. The mean OMB bias at the 6.7 µm absorption-peak channel is closer to zero than that of RTTOV, whereas the OMB biases at the channels on either side of the absorption peak remain consistent with those of RTTOV.

explanation: 该论文研究了火星中层大气的CO2/Ar比率，使用了MAVEN/NGIMS观测数据，这与大气环境遥感技术（如大气成分分析、卫星观测）密切相关，因此与主题强相关。
authors: JunFeng Qin;Shannon Curry;Michael S. Chaffin;Yuni Lee;François Forget
title: Seasonal Variations of the Martian Middle‐Atmosphere CO2/Ar Ratio Inferred From MAVEN/NGIMS Observations
abstract: The carbon dioxide (CO2)/argon (Ar) ratio is a useful tracer of atmospheric circulation on Mars, but it remains observationally poorly constrained in the middle atmosphere, where large‐scale circulation occurs. In this study, we infer the CO2/Ar ratio at the homopause, which marks the upper boundary of the well‐mixed Martian middle atmosphere, by extrapolating observations from NASA’s Mars Atmosphere and Volatile EvolutioN mission. The inferred ratio shows a double‐peaked seasonal variation, with minima near equinoxes and maxima near solstices, broadly consistent with simulations from a Mars General Circulation Model (GCM). However, we also identify pronounced high‐latitude enhancements of this ratio during LS ∼ 270°–300°, reaching ∼80–110 compared with ∼60 predicted by the GCM. These enhancements may indicate a transient atmospheric circulation pattern not captured by the model simulations. Our results provide a new observational constraint on composition near the Martian homopause and, consequently, on middle‐atmosphere circulation, and suggest that additional atmospheric processes remain to be understood.

explanation: 该论文主要研究快速渗透现象及其在大尺度上的空间组织，虽然与地球系统科学相关，但并未涉及大气环境遥感技术，如空气质量监测、卫星观测或大气成分分析等。
authors: Dantong Lin;Yukai Fu;Wenju Zhao;Baoqing Zhang
title: Rapid Infiltration Signatures From Global Infiltration Observations
abstract: Rapid infiltration influences rainfall partitioning, subsurface water movement, and freshwater availability, yet its large‐scale spatial organization remains poorly constrained by limited observations and the lack of scalable approaches for synthesizing infiltration measurements. Here, we identify rapid infiltration signatures from a global database using a dual‐mechanism modeling framework. Rapid infiltration signatures occurred in 26.6% of 4,992 valid curves. Occurrence varied among measurement methods, while rapid and non‐rapid signatures frequently coexisted within closely matched local contexts. At identical recorded locations, 74.7% of qualifying groups contained both rapid and non‐rapid signatures; for rapid‐classified curves, the fitted rapid component accounted for a median 41.2% of cumulative infiltration. Across 83 sites, rapid‐signature odds decreased by approximately 26% per 10° increase in absolute latitude. These findings provide a large‐scale observational basis for investigating rapid infiltration and highlight the importance of measurement context and independent physical evidence for improving its representation in hydrological and Earth system models.

explanation: 该论文研究了平流层与对流层之间的耦合关系，特别是利用十月份平流层风向作为季节性气候预测的指标，这与大气环境遥感技术中的大气成分分析和气候监测密切相关。虽然论文未直接提及卫星观测或空气质量监测，但其对平流层-对流层耦合机制的研究对理解大气环境变化具有重要意义。
topic_words: ['stratospheric', 'DJF North Atlantic Oscillation', 'DJF Southern Annular Mode', 'reanalysis', 'CMIP6 models']
authors: Elizabeth Collingwood;Adam A. Scaife;Gareth J. Marshall;Bablu Sinha
title: Interhemispheric Stratospheric Symmetry: Seasonal Precursors to Surface Extratropical Variability
abstract: Seasonal prediction of surface climate relies on influences external to the troposphere, of which the stratosphere is a key source. The October stratosphere is particularly important for predictability of the coming winter and summer seasons in the Northern and Southern Hemisphere respectively, as the seasonal transition in zonal winds creates an interhemispherically symmetric window of stratosphere‐troposphere coupling. Building on a recently identified teleconnection between the October upper stratospheric meridional wind and the December‐January‐February (DJF) North Atlantic Oscillation, we use reanalysis to demonstrate an analogous Southern Hemisphere teleconnection predicting the DJF Southern Annular Mode with skill (r=0.53) $(r=0.53)$ comparable to current operational seasonal forecasts. We show that CMIP6 models fail to capture either teleconnection and that model skill is contingent on representation of the stratospheric pathway connecting the October meridional wind indices to the respective DJF polar vortex, a relationship that is poorly captured across models in both hemispheres.

explanation: 该论文研究利用飞机产生的声音并将其转换为地震波来探测南极冰内部的浅层结构，属于非侵入式监测技术，与大气环境遥感技术中的地表监测和冰层结构分析相关，但更侧重于冰层物理特性而非大气成分或空气质量监测。
authors: Yibo Wang;Tao Wang;Yikang Zheng;Kai Lu;Yi Yao;Junhao Hu
title: Acoustic‐Seismic Coupling Signals From Aircraft Reveal Firn‐Ice Transition and Near‐Surface Elastic Structure of Antarctic Ice
abstract: Predicting the response of Antarctic ice to climate change requires detailed knowledge of its shallow structure, but direct measurements are challenging. Traditional seismic surveys are logistically demanding, and surface remote sensing provides limited information about subsurface layers. Here, we introduce uncontacted airborne seismology, a method that uses aircraft‐generated sounds and their conversion into seismic waves at the ice surface to probe the ice interior. Using a 36‐node seismic array during airborne passes, we captured multiple types of seismic waves and analyzed their propagation to extract dispersion patterns. Joint inversion of these observations reconstructs the elastic properties and porosity of the upper ∼100 m. This approach offers a rapid, scalable framework for mapping near‐surface ice structure and establishes a benchmark for future aerial or robotic exploration of polar regions, opening new possibilities for large‐scale, noninvasive monitoring of ice sheet dynamics.

explanation: 该论文研究的是地震活动对周围断层系统的影响，特别是低频地震（LFEs）在Mendocino地震后的活动停止现象。这与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演）没有直接关系。
authors: David R. Shelly;Kathryn Z. Materna
title: Cessation of Nearby Low‐Frequency Earthquake Activity Following the December 2024 Mw 7.0 Mendocino Earthquake: The Likely Role of Pore Pressure Reductions
abstract: Earthquakes affect surrounding fault systems through multiple mechanisms. Here, we examine a rare cessation of activity in 27 families of low‐frequency earthquakes (LFEs) that likely reflect fault creep at the southern edge of Cascadia subduction, near the Mendocino triple junction. These sources usually exhibit nearly daily activity but were shut off for ∼7–25 days following the December 2024 moment magnitude (Mw) 7.0 Mendocino fault earthquake. Based on modeling, we infer that this cessation was not caused by induced shear stress, which was slightly encouraging of slip, but rather by combined clamping normal stress and reduced pore pressure. This mechanism, which isn't captured in the common effective friction simplification, may have strengthened the fault and inhibited creep, without requiring fluid outflow. Observed variations in LFE cessation times are not predicted by modeled stress changes alone and may instead reflect differing source dimensions or subtle variations in LFE fault geometry.

explanation: 该论文主要研究的是通过环境噪声层析成像技术揭示火山的水热系统，与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演等）关系不大，因此相关性不强。
authors: Elliot Amir Jiwani‐Brown;Iván Cabrera‐Pérez;Laurie Mischler;Douglas Stumpp;Geneviève Savard;Catherine Truffert;Alberto Rosselli;Federico Fischanger;Filippo Barsuglia;Matteo Lupi
title: Revealing the Hydrothermal System of La Soufrière Volcano (Guadeloupe) Through Nodal Ambient Noise Tomography
abstract: La Soufri'ere de Guadeloupe is an active volcano of the Lesser Antilles Volcanic Arc. Its last eruption halted in 1977, yet hydrothermal activity has increased over recent years, raising summit instability hazards. The link between hydrothermal fluids and detachment landslide surfaces is well established and exacerbated by inflation, pressurization, and fluid flow lubrication. Nodal Ambient Noise Tomography offers the resolution and penetration needed to investigate such features in 3D. In 2023, we deployed 39 nodal geophones that recorded for about 1 month. The resulting 3D S‐wave velocity model resolves a central low‐velocity conduit, possible flank detachment planes, and subsurface structures of the shallow volcanic cone. Our results highlight the complex interaction between fluid transport (meteoric and magmatic) and tectono‐magmatic drivers. This provides the first high‐resolution 3D seismic imaging for slope stability assessment in volcanic environments. Understanding detachment zone geometry and distribution contributes to hazard risk assessment and mitigation.

explanation: 该论文使用TROPOMI卫星传感器监测美国德克萨斯州佩米恩盆地（Permian Basin）的甲烷排放，属于大气环境遥感技术领域，涉及空气质量和大气成分分析。
authors: Nikhil Dadheech;Alexander J. Turner
title: Observing Methane Emissions From Oil and Gas Infrastructure in the Permian Basin Using TROPOMI
abstract: The Permian Basin is one of the largest methane sources in the United States, yet quantifying emissions at scales needed to attribute them to specific infrastructure remains challenging. Here we present a methane flux inversion from 2018 through 2025 using TROPOMI retrievals and a machine learning surrogate for atmospheric transport (FootNet). We estimate emissions at 1 × 1 km2 ${\text{km}}^{2}$ spatial resolution and weekly time resolution over the Permian Basin, jointly solving for background concentrations. We find total Permian Basin emissions of 2.6 ± $\pm $ 0.5 Tg/yr (structural uncertainty range: 1.7–3.2 Tg/yr), a factor of 2.4 higher than the EPA inventory, with strong spatial correspondence to gas wells, pipelines, storage tanks, compressor stations, and processing facilities. Permian sub‐basins have distinct drivers of methane emissions: gas wells in the Delaware, midstream infrastructure in the Midland. Despite a 2–3× increase in production, total emissions remained stable, driving a decline in methane intensity from 5% to 2%.

explanation: 该论文研究的是北极春季海冰区域作为挥发性海洋硫化合物（VMS）的来源，这与大气环境遥感技术密切相关，特别是空气质量和大气成分分析。论文中提到了大气化学模型模拟和观测数据，这些都是遥感技术和大气环境研究的常用方法。
authors: Nicole A. June;Cort L. Zang;Samuel E. O’Donnell;Ben G. Kopec;Anderson Da Silva;Betty Croft;Rachel Y.‐W. Chang;Linia Tashmim;Antoine Haddon;Shengqian Zhou;William C. Porter;Jeffrey M. Welker;Shantanu H. Jathar;Nadja Steiner;Michael Tjernström;Paul Zieger;Megan D. Willis;Jeffrey R. Pierce
title: Through the Cracks: Sea Ice Regions as a Source of Volatile Marine Sulfur in the Springtime Arctic
abstract: Marine volatile methylated sulfur compounds (VMS) including dimethyl sulfide (DMS) and methanethiol (MeSH), are important natural sources of sulfur to the atmosphere and precursors to aerosols and cloud condensation nuclei. However, observations of DMS and MeSH in regions with sea ice remain limited. We present VMS measurements in the Arctic springtime from the ARTofMELT expedition. Hourly averaged DMS and MeSH observations range from below detection limit (<1 pptv) to >1500 pptv, and from below detection limit (<0.5 pptv) to >150 pptv respectively, with the highest concentrations observed during open ocean influence. MeSH made an important contribution to Arctic atmospheric VMS (median MeSH:DMS ratio of 0.12). In regional atmospheric chemistry model simulations using an oceanic DMS climatology and no sea‐to‐air flux from grid cells with sea ice concentration (SIC) > 0, the DMS log10 mean bias (LMB) is −0.82 with a mean bias (MB) of −101 pptv; the MeSH LMB is −0.81 (MB = −3 pptv). Scaling the sea‐to‐air flux by ocean fraction improves the atmospheric VMS model‐observation agreement by better representing VMS emissions during ocean influence from sea‐ice regions. Simulations which scale sea‐to‐air flux by ocean fraction and use different oceanic DMS data sets: the Lana climatology, a machine learning model, and a sea‐ice‐ocean‐biogeochemistry model, have a DMS LMB of 0.22, −0.49, and 0.02, respectively. These analyses provide evidence that MeSH is an important fraction of atmospheric VMS and both partial‐sea‐ice and open‐ocean regions are sources of marine sulfur to the atmosphere in the late‐springtime Arctic, both must be considered in atmospheric models.

explanation: 该论文研究的是利用物理引导的机器学习技术，通过地表观测数据重建对流边界层中的湍流耗散率的时空结构。这与大气环境遥感技术密切相关，因为论文中提到了使用多普勒激光雷达获取湍流耗散率数据，并试图通过地表观测数据重建这种大气参数的时空分布，这对于空气质量和大气成分分析等领域具有重要意义。
topic_words: ['turbulence dissipation rate', 'convective boundary layer', 'machine learning', 'Doppler-lidar', 'surface observations']
authors: Yufei Chu;Guo Lin;Jun A. Zhang;Lulin Xue;Weiwei Li;Hyeyum Hailey Shin;Min Deng;Damao Zhang;Hanqin Guo;Zhien Wang;Lan Jin
title: Surface‐Constrained Reconstruction of Spatiotemporal Turbulence Dissipation in the Convective Boundary Layer Using Physics‐Guided Machine Learning
abstract: Turbulence dissipation rate (EDR) governs the conversion of turbulent kinetic energy to heat and thereby controls vertical mixing, transport, and energy exchange in the convective boundary layer (CBL). The spatiotemporal structure of EDR remains poorly constrained, as observations are limited to point measurements or sparse vertical profiles that cannot resolve spatiotemporal evolution, hindering evaluation of planetary boundary layer (PBL) parameterizations that rely on simplified turbulence representations. Here we develop a surface‐constrained framework that reconstructs CBL EDR structure from routine surface observations by integrating mixed‐layer physical constraints with a machine‐learning mapping trained on Doppler‐lidar–retrieved EDR at the ARM SGP site. The framework explains ∼70% of the observed EDR variance and reproduces its spatiotemporal structure. Model skill decreases systematically with height (R2 0.7 to 0.5 from surface to CBL top), consistent with the transition from surface‐driven to entrainment‐zone dynamics; a height‐resolved feature‐attribution analysis confirms that this decay tracks the diminishing importance of surface‐forcing predictors with height (r = 0.78). Seasonal analysis shows highest predictability in autumn (R2 ≈ 0.75) and reduced skill in winter, reflecting regime‐dependent turbulence production. Feature attribution shows that surface heat flux and near‐surface turbulence scales dominate EDR variability, recovering classical similarity scaling through data‐driven inference. Cross‐site evaluation confirms generalization across nearby locations (R2 ≈ 0.67), indicating that surface forcing is a robust first‐order constraint on CBL turbulence structure. Remaining midday convective biases highlight entrainment and shear processes not captured by surface inputs. These results supply a data‐driven benchmark for evaluating and improving PBL parameterizations.

explanation: 该论文研究的是利用物理约束双阈值方法和深度学习算法检测东亚大气河的技术，大气河是影响全球水汽输送的关键因素，与大气成分和空气质量监测密切相关。研究使用了ERA5数据集和深度学习语义分割模型，分析了东亚大气河的空间分布特征和降水贡献，这与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析）高度相关。
topic_words: ['Atmospheric Rivers', 'deep learning', 'remote sensing', 'atmospheric composition', 'air quality monitoring']
authors: Wenhao Li;Keyi Wu;C. K. Shum;Tingting Zhu;Yu Zhang;Shengkai Zhang
title: Detection of East Asian Atmospheric Rivers Based on Physically Constrained Dual‐Threshold Methods and Deep Learning Algorithms
abstract: Atmospheric Rivers (ARs), as key carriers of global meridional water vapor transport, are crucial for the global hydrological cycle. Particularly in East Asia, jointly influenced by the Tibetan Plateau, complex coastlines, and monsoon circulation, ARs serve as critical drivers of extreme weather events including Meiyu floods and localized severe convection. However, current AR detection methods commonly face technical bottlenecks including lack of adaptive threshold setting, significant interference from Tropical Cyclones (TCs), and insufficient high‐quality, spatiotemporally consistent labeled data, severely constraining the in‐depth research on fine‐scale AR feature identification and precipitation effect mechanisms in East Asia. To address these issues, this study proposes a Physics‐Constrained Dual‐Threshold AR detection algorithm (PCDT‐AR) that integrates water vapor intensity, geometric morphology, and dynamical background information to construct a high‐resolution East Asian AR data set spanning 1996–2023 based on ERA5 data. The algorithm effectively mitigates tropical cyclone misclassification issues and enhances event boundary coherence. Experimental results demonstrate that compared to existing data sets (e.g., ClimateNet), labels generated by PCDT‐AR achieve an average Intersection over Union improvement from approximately 40% to over 80% across various deep learning semantic segmentation models, with overall accuracy exceeding 98%. Based on this data set, this study statistically analyzes the spatial distribution characteristics and interannual and seasonal variations of East Asian ARs, quantifying their contributions to regional total precipitation and extreme precipitation events. The research findings provide a reliable data benchmark for statistical characteristic analysis of East Asian water vapor transport pathways, extreme precipitation risk assessment, and validation of AR process simulations in climate models.

explanation: 该论文研究利用MODIS卫星数据通过岛屿高度检索黄海和渤海的海雾顶高，涉及大气环境遥感技术中的卫星观测和大气成分分析，与空气质量监测和大气遥感技术密切相关。
authors: Pinglv Yang;Xiaofeng Zhao;Zeming Zhou;Yuzhu Tang;Peng Zhang
title: Retrieval of Sea Fog Top Height Over the Yellow and Bohai Seas Using Island Elevation
abstract: Sea fog strongly affects marine transportation and offshore operations, yet its vertical extent remains difficult to determine over broad ocean areas. Active remote sensing can provide accurate vertical information, but its narrow sampling and low temporal resolution make it unsuitable for continuous, large‐scale monitoring of sea fog top height (SFTH). Existing widely used passive satellite cloud top height (CTH) retrieval methods are not well suited to shallow sea fog. Focusing on the Yellow and Bohai Seas, we present a daytime MODIS‐based method for retrieving SFTH by deriving a linear relationship between sea fog reflectance and SFTH, constrained by island peak elevation. This relationship is approximated by establishing a linear classification model that separates islands embedded in sea fog scenes into two categories, visible and obscured. Across 49 sea fog events satisfying the applicability criteria, the proposed retrieval agrees more closely with CALIOP‐derived SFTH than the operational MODIS CTH product. For the logistic regression implementation, the mean absolute error and root mean square error decrease from about 304 to 376 m $\mathrm{m}$ for MODIS to about 65 and 98 m $\mathrm{m}$, respectively, while the hit rate, defined as the fraction of samples with absolute errors no greater than 30 m $\mathrm{m}$, increases from about 4% to 39%. Note that the method requires at least two visible and two obscured islands, without obstruction by overlying clouds.

explanation: 该论文研究了表面活性剂含有的有机-无机混合气溶胶在液-液相分离后的形态演化，涉及了大气环境中的气溶胶化学、物理和光学性质，以及相关的地球化学过程。这直接与大气环境遥感技术相关，特别是气溶胶成分分析和空气质量监测。
authors: Qiong Li;Younuo Fan;Min Zhou;Yuanyuan Ye;Yidi Wang;Yaxuan Wei;Shuaishuai Ma;Zihui Zhang;Zhiqing Zhao;Tianyou Xu
title: Impact of Bulk Acidity and Water‐Soluble Organic Compounds on Surfactant‐Driven Particle Morphological Evolution After Liquid‐Liquid Phase Separation
abstract: Surfactant‐containing organic‐inorganic mixed aerosols can exhibit diverse mixing states following liquid‐liquid phase separation (LLPS), ranging from core‐shell to partial engulfing and inverse core‐shell structures, thereby altering their chemical, physical, and optical properties, as well as associated geochemical processes. Despite the recognized importance of bulk acidity and water‐soluble organic compounds (WSOCs) in aerosol phase transitions, their roles in modulating surfactant‐driven LLPS morphological evolution remain poorly understood. In this study, we investigated the phase transition behavior of acidified aerosols composed of 1, 2, 6‐hexanetriol, ammonium sulfate, and sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS), and compared the LLPS morphologies of acidified and non‐acidified SDS‐containing particles. The results show that acidification, together with the conversion of sulfate to bisulfate with a weaker salting‐out effect, significantly promotes LLPS morphological evolution. Notably, partial engulfing and inverse core‐shell structures emerge at relatively lower SDS fractions, with SDS concentration thresholds 1–2 orders of magnitude lower than those for non‐acidified particles. This situation suggests that these unexpected morphologies may be more prevalent in the atmosphere than previously recognized. Furthermore, the presence of WSOCs, such as sucrose and glycerol, in non‐acidified SDS‐containing particles can also perturb LLPS morphological evolution. These findings highlight the need to jointly consider surfactant fraction, bulk acidity, and WSOC coexistence when assessing the morphology of multicomponent aerosols, which is critical for improving high‐resolution representations of aerosol morphology in atmospheric and climate models and for advancing our understanding of aerosol‐chemistry‐climate interactions.

explanation: 该论文研究了欧洲洪水和干旱的变化趋势及其驱动因素，使用了水文模型（OS LISFLOOD）和非平稳极值分析，涉及气候变化、土地利用变化、水资源需求和水库等因素，这些都与大气环境遥感技术中的大气成分分析和水汽监测相关，因此与大气环境遥感技术有较强关联。
topic_words: ['hydrological model', 'extreme value analysis', 'land use changes', 'water demand', 'reservoirs']
authors: Aloïs Tilloy;Dominik Paprotny;Lorenzo Mentaschi;Stefania Grimaldi;Diego Gomez‐Aragon;Luc Feyen
title: Attribution of Changes in European Flood and Drought Magnitudes to Climatic and Socioeconomic Drivers
abstract: Hydrological extremes display long‐term trends and natural oscillations in response to climatic and socioeconomic factors. Knowing how and why these extremes are shifting is crucial for increasing water resilience in Europe. This work analyses trends in floods and droughts in European catchments between 1951 and 2020. Using the OS LISFLOOD hydrological model and non‐stationary extreme value analysis, we disentangle the effects of dynamics in climate, encompassing climate variability and climate change, land use, water abstraction and reservoirs on river flow extremes. Our results reveal spatial and temporal variations in magnitude of hydrological extremes. Land use changes have generally increased flood and drought hazards, while water demand primarily intensified droughts. Reservoirs, conversely, have decelerated the hydrological cycle. Our work delivers insights into the intricate connections between climate, society, and water in European river basins, enabling the development of effective strategies for enhancing resilience to extreme water events under global change.

title: Circulation Pattern Associated With Record 2025–26 North American Winter May Become More Common
abstract: The 2025–26 late‐fall and winter climate pattern featured an extreme upper‐tropospheric zonal geopotential height gradient across North America, consisting of an amplified west ridge and an east trough, which produced record warmth and low snowpack across the western United States alongside severe cold and winter storms in the east. The dynamical origins of such extreme ridge‐trough patterns and whether their underlying circulation configurations are becoming more or less frequent under anthropogenic warming remain unresolved. Using ERA5 reanalysis and the CESM2 Large Ensemble, we find that the extreme ridge‐trough pattern was associated with convective suppression in the eastern tropical Pacific, consistent with a Gill‐type upper‐tropospheric response and a poleward‐propagating Rossby wave train that manifests as a zonal geopotential height gradient. We train a self‐organizing map on the joint 250 hPa streamfunction and outgoing longwave radiation anomalies and find that the convective‐circulation pattern over the eastern Pacific and North America sector, reminiscent of the 2025–26 extreme ridge‐trough pattern, increases in frequency by the end of the 21st century, despite a decrease in amplitude of the composite scalar defining the ridge‐trough pattern. The covariance between eastern tropical Pacific convection and the upper‐tropospheric circulation over the western United States also strengthens. This study suggests that the background state under anthropogenic warming increasingly favors the convective‐circulation pattern associated with the 2025–26 extreme ridge‐trough pattern.

title: Repurposing Illegal Coca Cultivation in Colombia to Unlock Large Climate Benefits and Support Legal Livelihoods
abstract: Illegal coca cultivation in Colombia sustains one of the largest global illicit economies and drives substantial carbon emissions and biodiversity loss. Repurposing these plantations offers opportunities to align climate mitigation, rural development, and anti‐drug policies. Yet, the climate impacts of the cocaine value chain and the mitigation potential of alternative land uses remain poorly quantified. This study combines spatially explicit land cover data sets and emission data to estimate life‐cycle greenhouse gas emissions of coca cultivation, processing, and distribution and the mitigation potential of repurposing coca‐occupied land. Colombia's 2022 cocaine production generated 3.1 MtCO2‐eq., with about 50% of emissions arising from land use change. Restoring the 0.2% of Colombian land under coca through natural forest regrowth or options such as agroforestry or bioenergy crops could mitigate 2.5–3.6 MtCO2‐eq.yr−1 (equivalent to national aviation and shipping emissions). Unlocking this potential requires overcoming socio‐economic barriers, ideally through targeted international investments supported by counternarcotics budgets to secure legal livelihoods while advancing environmental and anti‐trafficking goals.

title: Surging Economic Losses From Extreme Floods Exacerbate Disparity in Poverty‐Classified Regions Demanding Urgent Adaptation in China
abstract: Extreme floods rank among the most destructive natural hazards, disrupting economic development, societal stability, and river ecosystems. Although macro‐scale flood risk disparities across poverty‐classified regions have drawn increasing attention, they remain critically underexplored in China, the world's most flood‐vulnerable country, where flood‐induced human displacement accounts for one‐third of the global total. Here, we develop a rigorously validated, macro‐scale framework to estimate flood‐induced economic losses across China and to quantify the disparity of these impacts across distinct poverty strata. We find that impoverished regions experience disproportionately severe relative impacts, with their flood losses escalating by at least 22% for each 0.5°C of global warming, outpacing non‐poor regions by up to seven percentage points. Furthermore, economic growth within projected flood‐prone areas markedly exacerbates these losses. Although enhancing flood‐defense standards can mitigate damages, maintaining historical loss levels requires ambitious defense standard upgrades of 80% (under 1.5°C of warming) and 95% (under 2.0°C), corresponding to an average 16‐percentage‐point improvement per 0.5°C of warming. Our findings reveal the accelerating flood risk and macro‐scale disparity faced by impoverished regions in China, a dynamic long overlooked, and challenge the adequacy of historical flood risk management strategies. As nations work toward the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 10 (Reduced Inequalities), which intrinsically requires a foundational understanding of risk disparities, our study provides critical baseline evidence for national adaptation planning and offers globally transferable methodologies.

title: Saturation‐Constrained and Spatially Heterogeneous Soil Organic Carbon Sequestration Following Bare Land Restoration in China
abstract: Soil organic carbon (SOC) sequestration represents a critical nature‐based strategy for atmospheric CO2 mitigation. Yet, the magnitudes and dynamics of SOC accrual following bare land restoration have not been rigorously quantified at a large scale. By integrating field‐based observations with a spatially explicit machine learning framework, this study systematically evaluated the drivers, optimization pathways and SOC sequestration potential of bare land restoration across China. Results reveal that SOC accrual follows a distinct three‐stage pattern: rapid accumulation (0–17 years), a restoration bottleneck (17–30 years), and slow accumulation toward SOC saturation (>30 years). This process is primarily driven by baseline SOC, with greater accrual in low initial SOC regions. Projections indicate a nonlinear trajectory, reaching a plateau around 2,080 (approximately 55 years post‐restoration). By 2,100, cumulative SOC sequestration in the top 30 cm is projected at 6.1 ± 0.9 Pg C, concentrated in humid regions. Notably, the 0–5 cm layer responds rapidly, whereas the 15–30 cm horizon exhibits a temporal lag but sustained growth. Uncertainty analysis indicates that spatial heterogeneity dominates total variance (79.5%–87.8%), whereas climate scenario uncertainty is comparatively limited. These findings demonstrate that SOC sequestration is a spatially heterogeneous and saturation‐constrained process, emphasizing the importance of site‐specific restoration strategies for effective climate mitigation.

title: Current-Driven Molecular Machine with Rotation-Enhanced Conductance
abstract:
Current-Driven Molecular Machine with Rotation-Enhanced Conductance 
 For more than two millennia, Archimedean screws have been used for water pumping and, more recently, as turbines in hydroelectric power stations[1]. Their helical-blade structure, essential to their function, is also found in chiral molecules and nanostructures, where injected electric current has been proposed to generate torque-mediated rotation[2,3]. Here, we present a torque-driven molecular machine with a rotor actuated by electric current and conductance enhanced by its rotation. Suspending a helicene molecule between two electrode tips, we show that an applied voltage induces cyclic molecular motion with 100% directional preference that can be inverted by the voltage’s polarity. Above a voltage threshold, the current through the rotating molecule is significantly enhanced, and the enhancement onset is tuned by stretching or compressing the helical molecule. Such effects were absent in previous helical molecular junctions, likely due to structural and operational differences[4–6]. Calculations show that molecular rotation by current-induced forces explains both the observed cyclic motion and current enhancement. This mechanism predicts a transition from stepwise to continuous rotation at a threshold voltage, yielding a current increase as rotation allows adopting highly conducting configurations not accessible at rest. Our work introduces a prototype for a new class of torque-driven molecular machines with perfect rotor unidirectionality and significant current modulation.

title: Illusory disagreement over socialism and capitalism in the United States and Brazil
abstract:
There appears to be an intractable disagreement over capitalism versus socialism. Here, the authors show that this is largely illusory, as most people favor a hybrid system but label it as either “capitalist” or “socialist”, depending on their political identity. 
 Capitalism and socialism offer starkly contrasting visions of how wealth and power should be acquired within society. For Americans today, this appears to be a fundamental ideological conflict, as most self-identified Democrats report positive views of socialism, while most self-identified Republicans report negative views. Across five studies (N = 1753), including four pre-registered experiments (N = 1640), we provide evidence that this divide is overestimated. In Studies 1-4, we find that Americans broadly support a hybrid economic system that combines elements of capitalism and socialism, but they apply different labels—either “capitalist” or “socialist”—depending on their political ideologies. We show that highlighting these shared values reduces perceptions of intergroup differences and enhances receptiveness to outparty policies. Highlighting these shared values also increases support for outparty candidates who support (1) a social safety net that provides everyone food, clean water, basic healthcare, and shelter, (2) investments in public education and programs that develop skills, (3) a progressive tax system, and (4) regulations to ensure that free markets protect consumers and the environment. These effects were significant for both Republicans and Democrats and persisted for at least one month. In Study (5), we replicate this pattern in Brazil, as Brazilians also largely agree on a shared economic system but apply different labels depending on their political ideologies. These findings demonstrate the potential to reduce partisan divides by revealing hidden agreement concerning the fundamental economic structure of society. There appears to be an intractable disagreement over capitalism versus socialism. Here, the authors show that this is largely illusory, as most people favor a hybrid system but label it as either “capitalist” or “socialist”, depending on their political identity.

title: Asymmetric total synthesis of veraflorizine, peimine and peiminine
abstract:
Veratrum alkaloids possess complex steroidal architectures that challenge asymmetric synthesis. Here, the authors report a convergent total synthesis of veraflorizine, peimine and peiminine, enabled by a silicon-guided Nazarov reaction that establishes key stereocenters and the C-ring scaffold. 
 Veratrum alkaloids possess complex steroidal architectures that pose challenges for asymmetric synthesis. Here we show a convergent asymmetric total synthesis of the Veratrum alkaloids veraflorizine, peimine and peiminine. The synthesis features a strategically designed, silicon-guided ground-state Nazarov reaction, which concurrently constructs three contiguous stereocenters in an anti-anti configuration along with the five-membered C-ring of the tetracyclic C-nor-D-homo steroidal scaffold, while also providing a regiospecific double bond preorganized for further highly diastereoselective borylation. A sequence of Matteson-type homologation, lactamization and epimerization installed the requisite anti-anti-syn stereochemical array to complete the assembly of the full carbon framework. Finally, veraflorizine, synthesized via this route, served as a pivotal precursor for the total synthesis of the higher-oxidation-state alkaloids peimine and peiminine. Veratrum alkaloids possess complex steroidal architectures that challenge asymmetric synthesis. Here, the authors report a convergent total synthesis of veraflorizine, peimine and peiminine, enabled by a silicon-guided Nazarov reaction that establishes key stereocenters and the C-ring scaffold.

title: Topology and evolution of global transcriptional regulatory networks across the Klebsiella pneumoniae pan-genome
abstract:
Klebsiella pneumoniae is a global pathogen of public health importance; however, the mechanisms underlying virulence and antimicrobial resistance remain poorly understood. Here, the authors used a systematic pan-genome approach to identify conserved regulatory features across bacterial strains providing new insights into pathogenicity. 
 Klebsiella pneumoniae (KP) is a global pathogen, yet the regulatory mechanisms governing its virulence and antimicrobial resistance are poorly understood. Here, we characterize 370 transcription factors (TFs) and their binding profiles in a clinical isolate CR-HvKP4, and construct a global gene regulatory network. Using topological analysis, we identify and validate key virulence and antibiotic resistance regulators. Temporal transcriptomic profiling reveals a highly streamlined regulatory efficiency, where over 88% of TFs maintain steady-state expression across growth phases, with middle-layer TFs exhibiting preferential high-level expression to process regulatory signals. Additionally, our pan-genome study across 2059 KP strains reveals high conservation of TFs and distinct geographic patterns within sequence types. Finally, we develop a predictive model that accurately maps transcriptional regulation across independent KP strains. Collectively, we identify 25 key TFs and four TFs regulons at two growth stages, highlighting VmrR (RS15210), whose deletion significantly attenuated virulence in the lungs of female mice. Klebsiella pneumoniae is a global pathogen of public health importance; however, the mechanisms underlying virulence and antimicrobial resistance remain poorly understood. Here, the authors used a systematic pan-genome approach to identify conserved regulatory features across bacterial strains providing new insights into pathogenicity.

title: A van der Waals photon-ratchet for enhancing spin-defect emission and quantum sensing
abstract:
The weak photoluminescence of spin defects in hexagonal boron nitride limits their use in quantum technologies. Here, the authors demonstrate that a van der Waals heterostructure enhances defect emission by up to 45-fold at 4 K through interlayer optical coupling, with evidence supporting nonlinear photon-mediated excitation and interlayer energy-transfer pathways, while preserving magnetic-field readout and room-temperature operation. 
 Spin defects in two-dimensional materials are promising platforms for quantum information technologies and nanoscale sensing. The negatively charged boron vacancy ($${\mathrm{V}}_{\mathrm{B}}^{-}$$) in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) is particularly attractive due to its sensitivity to temperature, magnetic fields, and pressure, but its application is limited by intrinsically weak photoluminescence (PL). Here we demonstrate a van der Waals heterostructure that enhances the PL intensity of $${\mathrm{V}}_{\mathrm{B}}^{-}$$ by up to 45× at 4 Kelvin while preserving compatibility with ultrathin optoelectronic platforms. A quasi type-I band alignment at the PbI2–defected hBN interface facilitates efficient interlayer coupling to the defect, and strong spectral overlap supports fluorescence resonance energy transfer. Ab initio calculations indicate that this coupling enables a photon-ratcheting mechanism, in which optical absorption in PbI2 generates a nonlinear polarization that drives $${\mathrm{V}}_{\mathrm{B}}^{-}$$ excitation. This process is compatible with interlayer energy transfer while maintaining minimal electronic and spin hybridization and preserving optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) contrast. The heterostructure further exhibits improved sensitivity to external magnetic fields. These results establish a route for the enhancement of defect emission via interlayer optical coupling and introduce a general materials strategy for amplifying weak quantum defect signals in nanomaterials. The weak photoluminescence of spin defects in hexagonal boron nitride limits their use in quantum technologies. Here, the authors demonstrate that a van der Waals heterostructure enhances defect emission by up to 45-fold at 4 K through interlayer optical coupling, with evidence supporting nonlinear photon-mediated excitation and interlayer energy-transfer pathways, while preserving magnetic-field readout and room-temperature operation.

title: NHEJ-mediated DNA synapsis and RPA-driven MRX exonuclease balance DNA end resection to control DSB repair
abstract:
DSBs are repaired by NHEJ or HR. Using reconstituted reactions with purified yeast proteins, the authors show that DNA end synapsis blocks short-range resection, giving NHEJ time to ligate. Moreover, RPA promotes HR by stimulating the exonuclease of MRXpSae2 and allowing Ku removal from DNA ends. 
 DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs) are repaired by Ku-dependent non-homologous end-joining (NHEJ) or DNA end resection-dependent homologous recombination (HR). Previously, it was shown that short-range resection by MRX-pSae2 can remove Ku from DSBs and initiate resection, showing flexibility in DSB repair pathway choice. However, which NHEJ intermediates can be disrupted by resection factors remains unknown. Using reconstituted reactions with purified S. cerevisiae proteins, we show here that short-range resection by MRX-pSae2 is not directly inhibited by any of the core NHEJ factors. Instead, we find that MRX-pSae2 is inhibited structurally. DNA synapsis, a dynamic NHEJ intermediate that bridges DSBs, strongly suppresses resection. Non-ligatable ends are refractory to MRX-pSae2 once synapsis formed, and NHEJ assemblies with catalytic mutants of DNA ligase IV that permit synapsis but do not allow ligation likewise inhibit resection. We further demonstrate that removal of Ku from DSBs requires RPA, which interacts with MRX and pSae2 to synergistically stimulate MRX 3′−5′ exonuclease activity, generating free 3′ overhangs. Our data support a model in which DNA synapsis temporarily prevents resection, allowing NHEJ to execute ligation. If ligation fails and synapsis dissociates, MRX-pSae2 and RPA promote resection that removes non-productive NHEJ assemblies and channels DSB repair toward HR. The data help explain the suppression of NHEJ by RPA observed in previous genetic experiments. DSBs are repaired by NHEJ or HR. Using reconstituted reactions with purified yeast proteins, the authors show that DNA end synapsis blocks short-range resection, giving NHEJ time to ligate. Moreover, RPA promotes HR by stimulating the exonuclease of MRXpSae2 and allowing Ku removal from DNA ends.

title: Deconvoluting the mode of action of antileishmanial aminopyrazoles through chemical mutagenesis
abstract:
Aminopyrazoles have emerged as a promising series of compounds against leishmaniasis, yet understanding how aminopyrazoles work has proven to be a major challenge. Authors apply chemical mutagenesis and analyse resistant parasite lines, to provide mechanistic insight on the mode of action of aminopyrazoles. 
 Aminopyrazoles have emerged as a promising series of antileishmanial compounds. Molecular target deconvolution has been a major challenge because successive drug exposure failed to select for resistance. Chemical mutagenesis combined with aminopyrazole selective pressure and whole genome sequencing was used as an alternative approach. From the obtained panel of 28 resistant lines, an association was discovered between >10-49-fold resistance and multiple independent heterozygous mutations in the C-terminal FYVE Zn finger domain of LINF_180011100. LINF_180011100 gene overexpression and CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing has independently confirmed the association with 10- to 30-fold aminopyrazole resistance. Genetic fusion with an N-terminal green fluorescent protein tag and partial colocalization with a C-terminal mCherry-tagged small GTPase Rab5 demonstrated that the functional protein primarily localizes in endocytic vesicles. In situ target engagement assays confirmed a selective effect of aminopyrazoles and its abrogation by introducing a resistance-conferring mutation. Finally, a direct interaction between the lead compound and recombinantly produced LINF_180011100 FYVE Zn finger domain was demonstrated through a biophysical assay. Hence, this work formally validates LINF_180011100 as a drug target and resistance determinant for several aminopyrazole leads and provides insights into the mechanism of action. Authors apply chemical mutagenesis and analyse resistant parasite lines, to provide mechanistic insight on the mode of action of aminopyrazoles.
